pdb.note: Reference only. Not symbol-rich: 1128 COFF symbols, nearly all TPoolAllocation statics. Names come from RTTI.

status_legend.proven: direct read, write, or branch observed at the cited address in the pinned image
status_legend.suspected: mechanism observed but shipped value, owning subsystem, or per-team consumer unresolved
status_legend.unresolved: code and names exist; semantics not established
status_legend.not-examined: identified in RTTI, not analysed in this pass
status_legend.refuted: a specific hypothesis contradicted by observed bytes

claims.claim: Target is PE32 i386 with the pinned SHA-256; no PDB is available; RTTI is complete and is the only name source.
evidence: rizin iI: bintype pe, bits 32, lang msvc, baddr 0x400000
RSDS at file offset 0x18625c8, guid db6b159c652c9342b1950b30b1b8c179, age 1
claims.falsifier: A PDB is found matching that GUID and age, or the image base/section table differs from the recorded values.

claims.claim: The gameplay-tunables descriptor registers 76 (offset, name) pairs, including difficulty-indexed economy fields and separately named player/IA pinned-death multipliers.
evidence: registration call sites 0x00b94011-0x00b94909, one push <offset> / push 0 / push str.<name> triple each
claims.falsifier: Disassembly of the registration block does not show the listed offset/name triples.

claims.claim: Loader 0x00b914c0-0x00b921c1 copies 65 of those fields into fixed globals, so consumers are reachable by absolute-address xref without a PDB.
evidence: scripts/ai_tunable_map.py over a Rizin listing of that function
ai-tunable-globals.json (65 entries) with load and store site per field
claims.falsifier: A field store in that range does not target the recorded global.

claims.claim: Difficulty is a closed 1/2/3 enum at the economy initialiser: 1 selects the Facile block, 2 Moyen, 3 Difficile, and any other value selects an explicit neutral block (currency stock 0, three multipliers 1.0f). AI_VHARD is not a case here.
evidence: 0x00bb2775 movzx eax,[esp+0x1e]; three 'sub eax,1 / jz' at 0x00bb277a-0x00bb278b
claims.falsifier: A fourth difficulty case exists, or the neutral path writes a non-1.0 multiplier.

claims.claim: InfluenceMapAlwaysKnowAllUnits (global 0x020263a2) gates the visibility test in the influence-map update: when set, units enter the influence accumulation without a visibility byte check.
claims.falsifier: The jump target does not reach the influence accumulation, or a second visibility test exists downstream on the same path.

claims.claim: IgnoreInvisibleUnit (global 0x020263a1) is read in per-unit visibility bookkeeping, and the branch clamps a stored value to VisibilityMemoTimer (0x020263a4).
claims.falsifier: The flag branch does not reach the clamp, or the clamp uses a different global.

claims.claim: StockDeviseSupplementaire<Difficulty> pays a currency-stock advantage through the object at +0x270 initialised by 0x00bb2740.
claims.missing: Owning object type at esi, per-team consumer of +0x270, and shipped values.
claims.falsifier: +0x270 is read only by display code, or the object is not instantiated for AI teams.

claims.claim: BonusIAMoneyForSkirmish (0x02026390) is an AI-only skirmish money bonus.
evidence: name in the registration table at offset 0x0264
claims.missing: No absolute-address reader exists; a base-pointer reader was not located.
claims.falsifier: The field is read by a path that applies to both teams identically, or it is unused.

claims.claim: IgnoreInvisibleUnit direction of effect (making the AI ignore unseen units vs. letting it consider them) is not established.
claims.missing: Consumer semantics and the meaning of the per-unit counter compared at 0x0103779b.
claims.falsifier: A traced call path shows which side the branch favours.

claims.claim: The AI has unconditional (hard-coded) omniscient targeting.
evidence: the only visibility bypass found is data-flag-gated (P5)
TInfluenceMap exposes one virtual slot (0x01029750) with no visibility bypass in it
claims.scope: Refuted for the regions examined. This is not a claim that no such path exists anywhere in a 30 MB image.

claims.claim: Reaction latency, ammunition/fuel exemptions, deployment restrictions and unit valuation.
evidence: classes present: TIAStratThread, TModernWarfareUnitLogicFuelModule, TUnitLogicDataConsumptionModule, TDeploiementGamePhase, TCostComputer*

open_items: Decode NDF_Win.dat for shipped tunable values (largest gap).
Identify the object type and per-team consumer of +0x270..+0x27c.
Trace AI order latency via TIAStratThread.
Check whether AI ammo/fuel consumption differs from player consumption.

experiments.prediction: The 76 registered names appear in NDF with values; StockDeviseSupplementaireFacile > 0; InfluenceMapAlwaysKnowAllUnits in {0,1}.
experiments.falsifier: Names absent, or value domain contradicts the access width in code.

experiments.prediction: With no information advantage active, no AI order targets a unit with zero prior vision in the same replay.
experiments.falsifier: Orders resolve to units with no vision record at all (record as a logging gap before calling it a cheat).

experiments.prediction: On Hard: stock > 0, player damage multiplier < 1.0, IA pinned threshold != 1.0, remaining fields 1.0.
experiments.falsifier: All globals equal neutral defaults on every difficulty.

experiments.prediction: Under no exemption, AI and player units consume identical ammo/fuel for identical orders.
experiments.falsifier: AI consumption is lower for the same orders.
